predecessors.name: Shailodbhava Dynasty
predecessors.text: Toshala, the early Bhauma-Kara country of coastal Odisha

ledger.x: 736: Kshemankara-deva founds the Bhauma-Kara line in Toshala.
c. 756 (bridge): the line holds most of coastal Odisha. "The dynasty probably ruled most of the coastal Odisha by the time of king Shivakara I (c. 756 or 786)"; the page dates no conquest.
790: Pala invasions begin (same sentence as the Rashtrakuta invasions, 790-829).
829: the Rashtrakuta and Pala invasions end.
10th century (bridge 950): the Somavamshis take the Bhauma-Kara country.
c. 950 (bridge): the Bhauma-Kara line ends. Infobox "Disestablished: c. 10th century CE"; no firmer date on the page.

wars.name: Rashtrakuta and Pala invasions of Odisha
wars.outcome: "a series of Rashtrakuta and Pala invasions weakened and disintegrated the Bhauma kingdom"; Tribhuvana-Mahadevi I later reunified it.

certainty.note: No frontier is given; coastal Odisha is the only land the page names.
